about_the_game:
Let the rhythm of ancient rituals awaken your senses.
Rituals of Lust and Sin — Music of Pagan Desire is the official soundtrack to the erotic mythological adventure — a journey through the Slavic underworld of temptation and ecstasy.

This album blends primal drums, whispered chants, and mystical melodies that mirror the atmosphere of the game. Each track was crafted to capture the tension between passion and darkness — between body and spirit.

🎶 Features:

  • 194 fully mastered tracks from the world of Rituals of Lust and Sin

  • Slavic pagan themes — mystery, fire, and desire

  • Ambient and ritual compositions for total immersion

  • Includes both WAV and MP3 formats

  • Perfect for background listening, creative work, or ritual mood

Feel the pulse of the ritual.
Let desire sing through every note.
